findings.finding: AppRightPanels.tsx uses React.lazy + Suspense for all right-panel components. Each panel conditionally renders based on activeRightPanel matching a string literal. RightPanelType is a string union with 7 current types. New M4 panels follow the same pattern: extend the union, add lazy import, add conditional render block.

All CSS custom properties referenced in M4 design-tokens.json (--surface-elevated, --border-default, --text-primary/secondary/muted, --shadow-tiny/default, --radius-sm/pill, --shell-font-label/compact, --shell-line-compact) are defined in globals.css (base) and themes.ts (9 theme overrides). No missing tokens. The M4 design is 100% compatible with the existing token architecture.

CharacterTab already imports and calls getCharacterProfile, analyzeCharacterDepth, getCharacterRelationships. The Character Relationships panel can extend this existing tab rather than creating a standalone panel, or reuse the same API hooks.

EvaluationPanel is a complex component with multiple hooks (useEvaluationWorkflow, useEvaluationRecommendations, useEvaluationCheckpoints, useEvaluationQualityCheck, useEvaluationData). Uses useDialogFocusTrap for accessibility. The Evaluation Drill-Down panel design can either extend this panel or create a new panel that reuses the same data hooks.

9 themes (sorbet, slate, amber, forest, charcoal, cauldron, aurora, moonbeam, sepia) each define complete token sets. All tokens used by M4 design (--surface-elevated, --border-default, --text-primary/secondary/muted, --shadow-tiny/default) are defined per-theme. Badge semantic colors use fixed rgba values in design-tokens.json which are theme-independent — correct for consistent status semantics.

summary.key_insight: The locked design direction (Variant A) is fully compatible with the existing codebase architecture. No new infrastructure needed — just extend RightPanelType union, add lazy-loaded panel components, and consume existing backend APIs through existing hooks.
